status: implementation; infrastructure and synthetic-tested model architectures only
scientific_question: Does repeatedly recomputing local residue-to-residue messages from updated mutation-conditioned hidden states improve delta-delta-G prediction compared with using a structural context that is computed once and then kept fixed?
protein_macro_MAE: mean across proteins of mean absolute error across each protein's mutations

interpretation.description: recurrent graph neural network inspired by SWARM mappings

data.features: same frozen pre-stability-head ThermoMPNN / ProteinMPNN representations as experiment 1
data.component_order: upstream hidden[:2] (last decoder first), then WT embedding; preserve experiment 1 order

proteinmpnn_tensor_comparison.actual: full core.prot_mpnn.state_dict() after strict pinned ThermoMPNN checkpoint loading
proteinmpnn_tensor_comparison.dtypes: identical torch dtype; no casting for equality
proteinmpnn_tensor_comparison.values: torch.equal; exact equality, no tolerance; finite tensors required
proteinmpnn_tensor_comparison.failure: stop and report mismatches and maximum absolute difference; never loosen tolerance

splits.ineligible_reason: prior explicit inspection of individual mutation labels/errors in notebooks/01_baseline.ipynb
splits.selection: Exclude 1A32.pdb from eligibility and keep it in train; SHA256(UTF8(prefix + protein_id)) for the other 238 original train IDs; sort by (hash, protein_id); first 30 eligible IDs become head_holdout; all remaining original train IDs become train; store each list lexicographically
splits.head_holdout_scope: protected holdout for the new heads only; not an independent external benchmark for the entire system
splits.legacy_test_scope: previously inspected old test; not a new independent test set
splits.sequence_duplicates: report exact WT duplicates across splits without reassignment

development_access.membership_check: actual requested and source protein IDs before label loading; entire batch preflighted

graph.topology: per-node kNN excluding self; symmetric union; store both directed orientations
graph.edge_index: [2,E]; row 0 is source j; row 1 is destination i
graph.tie_break: immutable original zero-based WT sequence position

required.sequence: canonical WT str of length L

record.labels: separate MutationLabels; never in graph construction or cache
record.ambiguous_mapping: explicit error; never truncate, pad, repair or silently reindex

diagnostics.reachability: mean over starting residues; reached OTHER residues divided by L-1; singleton=0

model.attention_normalization: incoming edges per destination and mutation query; stable softmax

message_refresh.mutation_self: self messages every step; attention inactive
message_refresh.graph_static: once from mutation-injected H0; reuse same tensor without detach

model.reference_mode: same q in readout; omit local psi(q) injection only
